notes.title: Robot Female Hero Remastered announcement
notes.content:
Howdy everyone! Coming this year is a full, from the ground up, overhaul of Robot Female Hero. It includes: cut content from its original release back in 2017, remastered assets, less jank, no more softlocks, and lore plus gameplay that fits in more properly with the series onward. This will truly be the definitive way to start the series! 

But after some thought, we have decided to remove the original version of Robot Female Hero from sale on Steam. We do not feel as though that title, in its original state, should be a players first experience to the series. For those who have already purchased it: the title shall remain in your Steam Library and you’ll be able to reinstall the game whenever you wish.

Anyway; We all here at Rocket Tech can’t wait for Robot Female Hero Remastered to be released this year! And, we are in the works of doing a similar round of remastering for Robot Female Hero 2 & Robot Female Hero 3! Although we can’t confirm a release date for any of those titles yet.
Have a good one y’all!
